fields.tender_title: Tender for Setting up, Operations and Management of State Helpline

questions.query: What service is the Punjab department procuring?
questions.gold_span: Tender for Setting up, Operations and Management of State Helpline

questions.query: When is the deadline to submit the helpline bids?
questions.gold_span: Last date and time for submission of bids 06.10.2025, 14:00 hrs

questions.query: What EMD must a bidder provide for this procurement?
questions.gold_span: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) through online mode Rs. 36,00,000/- (Rs. Thirty Six Lacs only)

questions.query: What average annual revenue qualifies a bidder under the financial eligibility requirement?
questions.gold_span: The Bidder must have an average annual turnover of above INR 25 crores in the following financial years - FY 2021-22, FY 2022-23 and FY 2023-24
